description: This file defines a request handler class 'GetMyOrdersHandler' for fetching a user's orders in a web application, implementing MediatR's IRequestHandler interface, utilizing specifications and repository pattern to retrieve and map order entities to view models.

classes.name: GetMyOrdersHandler
classes.description: Handles fetching a list of orders for a specific user and mapping them to view models.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the GetMyOrders request by retrieving orders using a specification and mapping them to OrderViewModel objects.
